summary: Helus Pharma Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on a US exchange, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Certificate and Articles of Amendment as Exhibit 99.1, following a corporate name change from Cybin Inc. The filing is administrative in nature, reflecting a charter amendment, and includes no transaction terms, no price per share, no stake, no board recommendation, and no advisor. No special-situation event—acquisition, divestiture, tender, going-private, or restructuring—is disclosed. Watch for future filings clarifying any strategic implications.
